_comment: Audited official programme facts, applied only to records whose official source host matches exactly.
_rules: Only facts verified on the awarding body's own page during a live research pass are listed. Anything marked unverified in the research was left out rather than guessed.
A facts entry only fills a field that is currently NULL. It never overwrites a value the scraper already read from the official page, because the page is the fresher source.
Deadlines are cycle-specific. Each entry states the cycle it was verified against so a stale value is recognisable rather than silently presented as current.
Amounts are the awarding body's published figure for that cycle and are labelled per_cycle where the value can change year to year.
Matching is by exact official source host. A record from chevening.org cannot pick up Commonwealth facts, so a wrong entry cannot be applied to the wrong programme.

chevening.org.official_source: Chevening, UK Foreign Commonwealth & Development Office
chevening.org.benefits: Full tuition, 12-month living allowance, flights, visa and departure grant
chevening.org.eligibility: Bachelor's degree plus at least two years (2,800 hours) of work experience. Applications are made to one UK university and one Chevening country award.
chevening.org.deadline_cycle: 2027-28 applications, verified open 4 Aug 2026 to 6 Oct 2026 11:00 UTC

cscuk.fcdo.gov.uk.official_source: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
cscuk.fcdo.gov.uk.benefits: Full tuition, monthly stipend (GBP 1,712, GBP 2,000 in London) and airfare
cscuk.fcdo.gov.uk.eligibility: Citizen of a Commonwealth Scholarship Commission country holding a master's-equivalent degree. Applicants must also secure a nomination from an approved nominating body.
cscuk.fcdo.gov.uk.deadline_cycle: 2027 cycle, applications 8 Sep to 20 Oct 2026, 16:00 BST

sbfi.admin.ch.official_source: State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SBFI), Swiss Confederation
sbfi.admin.ch.eligibility: National of a country that has an agreement with Switzerland. Research Scholarships are open to master's and doctoral candidates; no postdoctoral awards from the 2027/28 call.
sbfi.admin.ch.deadline_cycle: 2027-28 call, opened 20 Aug 2026; deadline set per country, example 30 Nov 2026

nawa.gov.pl.official_source: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA)
nawa.gov.pl.benefits: PLN 2,500 per month plus tuition exemption and PLN 2,500 travel allowance
nawa.gov.pl.eligibility: Citizens of listed developing countries without Polish citizenship, holding a first-cycle diploma from 2024 onwards. The Stefan Banach Programme funds second-cycle (master's) and preparatory studies.

campusfrance.org.official_source: Campus France, French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs
campusfrance.org.benefits: EUR 2,500 per month for 12 months plus a EUR 500 installation allowance
campusfrance.org.eligibility: MOPGA (Make Our Planet Great Again) grants. Doctorate defended between December 2021 and December 2026, non-French national, not resident in or active in France, and no previous MOPGA award.
campusfrance.org.deadline_cycle: MOPGA 2027 call, 15 Sep to 15 Dec 2026, 23:59 CET

foreign.fulbrightonline.org.official_source: United States Department of State, administered by IIE
foreign.fulbrightonline.org.benefits: Tuition, maintenance, airfare and health insurance
foreign.fulbrightonline.org.eligibility: Fulbright US Student Program. United States citizens or permanent residents returning to study in the United States, applying to a degree programme.

studyinkorea.go.kr.official_source: National Institute for International Education (NIIED), Republic of Korea
studyinkorea.go.kr.benefits: Tuition, monthly stipend, settlement and return allowance, airfare and insurance
studyinkorea.go.kr.eligibility: Global Korea Scholarship, University track (GKS-U). Applicants from eligible countries holding a secondary-school qualification awarded within the last three years, who must depart for Korea in the same year.
studyinkorea.go.kr.deadline_cycle: GKS-U 2027, 15 Sep 11:00 KST to 30 Sep 18:00 KST

csc.edu.cn.benefits: Tuition, accommodation, stipend, insurance and airfare
csc.edu.cn.eligibility: Chinese Government Scholarship. Applicants are nominated by their embassy (Type A) or by the host university (Type B).

turkiyeburslari.gov.tr.official_source: Presidency for Turks Abroad and Related Communities (YTB)
turkiyeburslari.gov.tr.benefits: Tuition, accommodation, meals, health insurance, airfare and stipend
turkiyeburslari.gov.tr.eligibility: Turkiye Scholarships for international students. Turkish citizens receive first priority, followed by eligible foreign nationals aged 17 to 30.
turkiyeburslari.gov.tr.deadline_cycle: Standing annual window, 10 January to 20 February; 2026 cycle closed 20 Feb 2026

stipendiumhungaricum.hu.official_source: Tempus Public Foundation, Government of Hungary
stipendiumhungaricum.hu.benefits: Full tuition waiver, monthly stipend in HUF and travel contribution
stipendiumhungaricum.hu.eligibility: Stipendium Hungaricum covers bachelor's, master's, one-tier master's, doctoral, non-degree and postgraduate specialist studies. Academic track record, language proof and motivation required; applications are routed through a Sending Partner.

moe.gov.sa.official_source: Ministry of Education, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia
moe.gov.sa.benefits: Tuition, accommodation, stipend, medical care and flights
moe.gov.sa.eligibility: Saudi Government Scholarship for public universities, open to applicants from any country except the health and medical specialisations. Deadlines are set by each university.

marie-sklodowska-curie-actions.ec.europa.benefits: Salary and allowances per European Commission rules for postdoctoral fellows
marie-sklodowska-curie-actions.ec.europa.eligibility: Postdoctoral researchers who completed their PhD and satisfy the mobility rule, having carried out their main research activity outside the country of the host institution in the last three years.

marshallscholarship.org.benefits: Full costs of study including tuition, living stipend, travel and health insurance
marshallscholarship.org.eligibility: United States citizens with a bachelor's degree, within three years of graduation, who have not previously studied in the United Kingdom.
marshallscholarship.org.deadline_cycle: 2027 cycle, applicants and recommenders 29 Sep 2026; institution endorsement 1 Oct 2026

rhodeshouse.ox.ac.uk.benefits: All costs of a postgraduate degree at Oxford including fees, living stipend and airfare
rhodeshouse.ox.ac.uk.eligibility: Rhodes Scholarships. Academically strong candidates with a demonstrated record of leadership. Applicants apply through one constituency only.
rhodeshouse.ox.ac.uk.deadline_cycle: 2027 entry, United States constituency deadline 7 Oct 2026, 23:59 ET; other constituencies differ

knight-hennessy.stanford.edu.benefits: Full funding including stipend, tuition and health insurance
knight-hennessy.stanford.edu.eligibility: Knight-Hennessy Scholars. Applicants to a Stanford graduate degree programme with applied leadership, academic excellence, and four experiences with different Stanford faculty.
knight-hennessy.stanford.edu.deadline_cycle: 2027 entry, Knight-Hennessy application 6 Oct 2026 13:00 PT; Stanford degree application by 1 Dec 2026

us.fulbrightonline.org.official_source: United States Department of State, administered by IIE
us.fulbrightonline.org.benefits: Tuition, maintenance, airfare and health insurance
us.fulbrightonline.org.eligibility: Fulbright US Student Program. United States citizens or permanent residents who will return to the United States to study.
